purpose: Compile-only diagnosis of paraphrase invariance for an already verified multi-source reduction.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_PARAPHRASE_001.json').read_text())['goal']
try:
 out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
 print(json.dumps({'status':'COMPILED','mode':out.get('compiler_mode'),'clauses':out.get('clauses'),'parts':out.get('compiled_parts')},sort_keys=True))
 print('PARAPHRASE_COMPILER_COMPILED')
except Exception as exc:
 print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)},sort_keys=True))
 print('PARAPHRASE_COMPILER_BLOCKED')
PY
